enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Move arm under pillow. Turn to back. Slightly open eyes. Close eyes again. Turn to left side. Pull blanket down.

Turn on light. Walk to toilet. Lift toilet seat. Urinate. Flush toilet. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth and spit. Rinse toothbrush. Put toothbrush down. Turn off light. Walk out.

Open refrigerator. Take out eggs. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour oil. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Slide eggs onto plate. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Cut egg. Lift fork to mouth. Chew. Swallow. Drink milk.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to office. Clock in.

Take temperature. Administer medication. Update records. Consult with doctor. Attend meeting. Use computer. Write notes.
Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Clear tray. Walk outside. Return to workplace.

enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Open door. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heartbeat. Take temperature. Administer medication. Update records. Consult with doctor. Attend meeting. Use computer. Write notes.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house. Remove shoes.

Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Turn off stove. Serve on plate. Sit at table. Eat. Drink water.
Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channel. Watch program. Adjust volume. Get up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return. Sit down. Continue watching. Turn off TV.
Open laptop. Turn on computer. Log in. Open browser. Check email. Browse internet. Type. Click. Scroll. Watch video. Chat with friend. Close browser. Shut down computer. Close laptop.
Walk to bedroom. Turn on lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read more. Close book. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Adjust pillow.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Dry face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap. Turn off light.

Lie on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Check messages. Scroll social media. Watch video. Type message. Send message. Check email. Look at photos. Set alarm. Put phone down. Turn off lamp. Close eyes.

Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Move arm under pillow. Turn to back. Slightly open eyes. Close eyes again. Breathe deeply.
